title: Detecting Fifth Metatarsal Fractures on Radiographs Through the Lens of Smartphones: The FIXUS AI Algorithm.
summary: Original full text compares smartphone-captured radiographs with fifth-metatarsal fracture labels in a clinical dataset and evaluates image-only, EHR-only and combined models on separate test data. Image-only model AUC was 0.99 in validation and 0.83 on its test set, a specific diagnostic result with test-set limitation. The result is reported in Cureus. The study does not establish generalization beyond its reported setting or prospective real-world benefit.
ai_technology: 1,240 fracture and 1,224 no-fracture records, smartphone radiograph pipeline, held-out datasets
